node.title: Re: Experimental keys on scalar is now forbidden
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my @variants = keys $hash{$word}{variants}; What is the right way to write it now?

The "right" way to write it, or rather, the way that will work on any version of Perl 5, is:

my @variants = keys %{ $hash{$word}{variants} };

Update: See also [doc://perlreftut], [doc://perlref], [doc://perldsc], and [id://1190788].

As of Perl 5.24, you can also make use of the [doc://perlref#Postfix-Dereference-Syntax]:

use 5.024; my @variants = keys $hash{$word}{variants}->%*;

(Update 2: It's actually been present since 5.20, but it was still experimental then and had to be explicitly enabled.)
